items.question: What happens in the 7-minute Fit-Check?
items.answer: You tell us your budget and what your family needs. We tell you which 3 East condos pass our test, and which ones to skip. No pitch. If we're not the right team for you, we'll say so.

items.question: Why only the East?
items.answer: Because no team can know every block on the island inside out. In the East we know which stacks get the afternoon sun, which face the expressway, and what each one really sold for. That's the part that saves you money.

items.question: Do you help with HDB flats?
items.answer: No. We only help families buy condos and ECs in the East (plus selling their current home as part of that upgrade). If you need a standalone HDB deal or a home outside the East, we'll point you to someone good.

items.question: New launch or resale. Which do you look at?
items.answer: Both. But we judge both the same way: against what real owners paid and sold for. A price list tells you what the developer wants. Past sales tell you what the market will pay.

items.question: What if no condo passes your test?
items.answer: Then we tell you to wait. We'd rather lose a sale than put your family in the wrong home.
